import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int mod = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        // Power function: computes a^n mod
        long power(long a, int n) {
            long result = 1;
            long base = a % mod;
            int exp = n;
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
                base = (base * base) % mod;
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        if (n % 2 == 1) {
            System.out.println(power(k, n));
        } else {
            long[] fac = new long[n + 1];
            long[] inv = new long[n + 1];
            fac[0] = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % mod;
            }
            inv[n] = power(fac[n], mod - 2);
            for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                inv[i] = (inv[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % mod;
            }

            List<Integer> list = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (((n & (1 << i)) != 0)) {
                    list.add(i);
                }
            }
            int cnt_list = list.size();

            int[] len = new int[n + 1];
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                int j = i;
                while (j != 0) {
                    len[i]++;
                    j = (j - 1) & j;
                }
            }

            boolean[] vis = new boolean[1 << n];
            for (int i = (1 << n) - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                if (i == 0) break;
                vis[i] = true;
            }

            long[][] dp = new long[n + 1][1 << n];
            dp[0][0] = 1;

            for (int mask = 0; mask <= (1 << n); mask++) {
                for (int s = 0; s <= n; s++) {
                    if (dp[s][mask] == 0) continue;
                    for (int sub = mask; sub != 0; sub = (sub - 1) & mask) {
                        int l = Math.min(k, len[mask ^ sub] + 1);
                        for (int s2 = 1; s2 <= l; s2++) {
                            if (dp[s - 1][mask ^ sub] != 0) {
                                dp[s][mask] = (dp[s][mask] + dp[s - 1][mask ^ sub] * inv[sub]) % mod;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            long answer = 0;
            int full_mask = (1 << n) - 1;
            for (int i = 0; i <= Math.min(k, len[n]); i++) {
                if (dp[i][full_mask] != 0) {
                    long tmp = dp[i][full_mask] * fac[k] % mod;
                    tmp = tmp * inv[k - i] % mod;
                    tmp = tmp * inv[i] % mod;
                    tmp = tmp * fac[n] % mod;
                    answer = (answer + tmp) % mod;
                }
            }
            System.out.println((power(k, n) - answer + mod) % mod);
        }
    }
}
